title: Express Your Feelings and Reach Out
author: MTCSTW
text: Join ANTIFA CEO MTCSTW for this episode streamed live to Kick, Twitch, Youtube, Facebook (MTCSTW and The Propaganda Factory), TikTok, and Substack. Thank you for all the patience and support as we continue to improve this experience for the working class movement. I was about to have a mental breakdown so I put on the suit and turned on the camera. Turns out the train already left the station. Experience it in real time with me and listen how my friends (people I met a few weeks ago on the internet) show up. If you are in crisis, reach out to anyone and everyone. We all care. The world is better with you. Feed a family this holiday with voixnoire.com Contact us direct via mtcstw.com
